title: Invoice list with filter and CSV export
describe: an invoice list with a status filter and csv export
prompt:
Build an invoice list at /.

Requirements:
- A heading "Invoices" and a table with the columns Number, Customer, Amount and Status.
- Six invoices, hard-coded: INV-001 Northwind $120.00 Paid; INV-002 Contoso $80.00 Paid; INV-003 Fabrikam $450.00 Overdue; INV-004 Tailspin $60.00 Draft; INV-005 Litware $300.00 Paid; INV-006 Adatum $75.00 Overdue.
- Filter buttons "All", "Paid", "Overdue" and "Draft". "All" is selected at first. Choosing one shows only invoices with that status.
- A button "Export CSV" that downloads the invoices currently shown as invoices.csv, with the header line number,customer,amount,status.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
